strategy.title: No executable plan: the $1,200 price is measured on HVAC software seats, not trucking fleets buying a workbook
strategy.why: The only opening's $1,200 price comes from Software Advice data on HVAC contractors paying for field-service management software per technician seat per year — a different buyer population and a different product (recurring software, not a one-off spreadsheet).
